question: Compare the spells Fireball and Lightning Bolt in D&D 5e. What are their similarities and key differences?
expected_answer: Both are 3rd-level Evocation spells available to Sorcerers and Wizards. Both deal damage (Dexterity saving throw, half on success) and scale at +1d6 per slot above 3rd. Key differences: Fireball has a range of 150 feet and hits a 20-foot-radius Sphere, dealing 6d8 Fire damage. Lightning Bolt originates from the caster (range: Self) and hits a 100-foot-long, 5-foot-wide Line, dealing 10d4 Lightning damage.
